art_direction: 浅玫纸底鼠尾草宽弧眼，开口松弛，安稳凝视。
composition_variation: Use broad resting bowls that remain clearly open. The left eye is two percent lower and twelve percent shallower, while the right is modestly wider. Both large black pupils regard the viewer and join soft curved upper lids. Keep identical sage-green bands gently swollen along the bottom curves, with short tapered ends and one slender long ivory glint inside each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
